thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2026-145 — spike in 5xxs and tail latency for dedicated pool us-west-2-dedicated-3 (auto-scale not adding nodes).

samir: paging oncall — I'm seeing a huge uptick on embedding and chat generate paths, errors ~15% 5xx for that pool. dashboards: https://grafana/internal/redwood/usw2/dedicated-3

jess: on it. can you confirm whether autoscale hit limit or failed to provision?

samir: looks like autoscaler logs show kernel OOM on the launcher, then rate-limit kicks in but pool stayed at 3 nodes.

mari: Ugh. we've hit the reserved hard cap for that tenant pool earlier — but these are shared-demand bursts from a marketing campaign.

samir: customer impact: several mid-market customers reporting slow/chat timeouts; external SLOs failing for a subset. not all tenants.

alex: quick mitigation proposals: 1) enable burst capacity toggle for us-west-2-dedicated-3, 2) emergency quota raise for impacted tenants, 3) apply coarse rate limit to non-essential routes (batch embeddings), 4) disable streaming on that pool.

jess: let's do (1) + (3) now. if burst toggle works, we'll roll back rate limits. who has perms to flip?

mari: I can flip burst toggle, but want to notify infra first. this is the sequence I recommend:
- turn on burst_capacity override for us-west-2-dedicated-3
- temporarily set per-tenant qps cap for large tenants to 60% of usual
- set route-based rate limit: /v1/embeddings batch -> 10r/s

samir: agreed. executing now. tagging @deploy-bot to record change.

samir: /infra toggle-burst --pool us-west-2-dedicated-3 --reason "INC-2026-145 traffic surge"

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Command received: /infra toggle-burst --pool us-west-2-dedicated-3 --reason "INC-2026-145 traffic surge" by samir. Change ID: change-8721.

mari: I'm monitoring provisioning. API shows nodes provisioning + KV-cache warming. tail latency improving for some shards.

jess: applying rate-limit to batch embeddings:
```yaml
rate_limit:
  route: "/v1/embeddings"
  scope: pool
  max_rps: 10
  reason: "emergency mitigation INC-2026-145"
```

deploy-bot: :warning: Rate limit rule applied to pool us-west-2-dedicated-3 (rule-id rl-5512).

samir: after burst flip, error rate dropped from 15% -> 6% in 3m. latency p95 still high for long contexts.

mari: slow p95 probably due to KV-cache cold start and backlogged requests. we can enable temporary fast-path config to skip noncritical plugins:
```json
{
  "pool": "us-west-2-dedicated-3",
  "feature_flags": {"plugin-logging": false, "streaming": false}
}
```

alex: Do we want to disable streaming? it impacts UX but reduces backend pressure. If we keep it on for premium tenants only, we need per-tenant routing.

jess: disable streaming for this pool for now. enable premium whitelist later. I'll apply feature flag.

jess: /infra set-feature-flags --pool us-west-2-dedicated-3 --flags "streaming=false,plugin-logging=false" --change "INC-2026-145"
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Feature flags updated (change-8723).

samir: operational note: autoscaler alert indicates provisioned nodes are at 85% capacity; burst capacity added 4 nodes. monitoring CPU and GPU mem.

mari: starting customer-impact assessment: list of impacted tenants and severity. I'll ping support to open incident notifications.

mari: support-notes draft: "We experienced degraded generation/embedding performance between 12:03–12:28 UTC for workloads routed to our us-west-2 dedicated pool. Mitigations included emergency burst-capacity enabling, route rate-limits on batch embeddings, and temporary feature disablement. Some customers saw elevated latencies and transient 5xx errors. We're monitoring and will follow up once fully recovered."

jess: good. samir can you hand off to next oncall once warmup stabilizes? I'm staying on for 15 more mins.

samir: yep. I'll create the handoff checklist in the thread and mark status.

samir: Handoff checklist:
- current status: burst enabled, +4 nodes, rl-5512 active, streaming disabled.
- next steps: watch p95 for 15m, validate KV cache hit rate, remove rate-limit if errors < 1% for 10m, revert feature flags after cache warm up.
- rollback commands:
```bash
/infra toggle-burst --pool us-west-2-dedicated-3 --state disable --change-id change-8721
/infra remove-rate-limit --rule rl-5512
/infra set-feature-flags --pool us-west-2-dedicated-3 --flags "streaming=true,plugin-logging=true"
```

alex: thanks. I'll keep an eye on billing alerts — burst nodes incur on-demand charges. need to confirm with finance if this is OK for the tenant group.

mari: support notified customers, and CS queued a proactive message for impacted accounts.

jess: marking incident as: mitigation in place, monitoring. will escalate to P1 if error rate creeps back up.

incidents-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: INCIDENT UPDATED INC-2026-145 — mitigation applied (burst enabled, rate-limit rule rl-5512, streaming disabled). assigned: samir -> next_oncall

samir: taking handoff. ping me if any regressions. I'll update the runbook with change IDs.

mari: thanks team. recovering metrics look promising. we'll reconvene in 30m for RCA planning. :thumbsup:
